# Synthetic restaurant HTML

Small hand-written fixtures model the public Visit South Walton Culinary Experiences form, card-deck, pager and listing-hero structures inspected on 2026-09-30. They contain invented businesses/contacts and no copied full live page. The listing template receives all 13 canonical labels plus the 3 excluded labels from test code, opaque synthetic values, selected filters, cards and pagination. Tests use MockTransport only; the suite-wide no_real_http guard remains enabled.
